description: Add the isolated tour-spike route and manifest parser, then provide Orbit, Move here, person-height Walk, Overhead, Reset, and Exit walk behavior. Navigation must use manifest-supplied walkable bounds, barriers, and cameras; remain local-only; and expose persistent homeowner labels, tooltips, focus behavior, live announcements, loading progress, and recoverable errors. Develop collision, placement, manifest trust, and page behavior test-first.
title: Build the homeowner hybrid tour controller
